description:
The Moon has ice, but nobody can say for sure whose water it is. We go through five suspects (comets, asteroids, lunar volcanoes, the solar wind and Earth), weigh the evidence for each, and look at the one measurement that could settle it.

What the 2025 review, the 2026 Nature Astronomy study and the ShadowCam survey actually say, and where they disagree.

Chapters
0:00 Five suspects
0:50 The scene of the crime: LCROSS at Cabeus
2:20 Suspect one: comets
4:00 Suspect two: asteroids
4:30 Suspect three: the Moon itself
5:50 Suspect four: the Sun
7:30 Suspect five: Earth
9:10 Two new studies: slow supply and ShadowCam
11:30 So who did it?
12:30 The missing measurement: heavy hydrogen

originality.notes: Onceki bolumlerden ayri: Ep3 Ay'in nasil olustugu, Ep4 Gateway/Ay ussu politikasi; bu bolum kutup buzunun kaynagi ve bilimsel tartisma. Uc Ay bolumu ust uste geldigi icin kanalin 'Ay kanali' gibi gorunme riski var; sonraki bolumde farkli bir konuya gecmek iyi olur. Kitle uretimi uzay videolarindan ayrisan yanlari: bes supheli yapisi, kuyruklu yildiz tartismasinin (kimyasal parmak izi vs. carpma fizigi) acik birakilip sonda geri cagrilmasi, 2026 Nature Astronomy ve ShadowCam sonuclari, ve 'hic olculmemis D/H orani' ana sorusu. Yaygin 'Ay'da su bulundu, hayat kurtarir' sablonundan uzak. Uyari: YouTube'da konunun ne kadar kalabalik oldugunu canli aramayla dogrulamadim; bu degerlendirme senaryo ve genel bilgiye dayali. Yayin oncesi dogrulanmasi gerekenler: S3/S4/S8 tam okunmamis; S17 ikinci elden ve gecici; Chang'e-7 tarihi (S18) teyitsiz.
